card.name: Amazoness Chain Master
card.effectSummary: When destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, its controller may pay 1500 LP, inspect the opponent's hand, and add one monster from that hand to their own hand.

tagDuelAdaptation.effectPlayer: active physical representative of the team whose Chain Master is in the shared Graveyard
tagDuelAdaptation.opponentSeat: must be supplied explicitly by the battle event and equal the active physical representative of the opposing team
tagDuelAdaptation.handSource: only the selected opponent active representative's physical hand; inactive partner reserves are never merged
tagDuelAdaptation.lp: 1500 is planned against shared team LP; this adapter does not commit the cost
tagDuelAdaptation.physicalOwnership: selected card UID prefix determines physicalOwnerSeat; transfer changes holderSeat only
tagDuelAdaptation.privacy: full inspected hand visible only to effectPlayerSeat; selected monster identity visible only to effectPlayerSeat and opponentSeat; partners and public output receive redacted projections
tagDuelAdaptation.resolution: re-reads the opponent hand at resolution; if no monster remains, cost stays paid and the effect is a no-op
tagDuelAdaptation.staleGuards: turn, active representatives, shared LP and current physical hand are revalidated

behavioralGroups: actual four-seat TagDuel state and active representatives
battle-destruction event and shared Graveyard validation
shared team LP cost planning without mutation
active opponent physical hand versus inactive partner reserve
physical owner preservation when holder changes
resolution-time monster availability and stale UID rejection
turn, active-seat, LP and duplicate-UID stale guards
forged-plan binding rejection and active-seat rotation
